example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজ নেই, বসে বসে ভেরেণ্ডা ভাজছি।
অফিসে কোনো কাজ না থাকায় সে ভেরেণ্ডা ভাজছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I have nothing to do, so I'm just twiddling my thumbs.
With no work at the office, he's killing time idly.
note: The idiom draws from traditional rural activities involving vegetable preparation, emphasizing pointlessness.
